name: Verification 7
definition: Method and data intended to be verified as well as the related results.

SubType.name: Sub Type
SubType.definition: Type of authentication for a given method (for example, three domain authentication, scheme proprietary solution, type of cryptogram, etc.).

Entity.name: Entity
Entity.definition: Entity who actually performed the verification.

OtherEntity.name: Other Entity
OtherEntity.definition: Other national or private entity in charge of the verification.

OtherResult.name: Other Result
OtherResult.definition: Additional result of the verification, for instance for electronic commerce.
